You can create basic weapons and armor with stones, as well as basic ammo. You need wood and stones for the ammo, and several boulders for each of the bigger items. The created weapons are quite heavy. The prices range from 1-4 boulders.

You can also construct rock decoys here. These act as an immobile sentry. It can reveal ambushes, and takes a lot of ammo to kill. Set them on a pillar, unreachable by melee attackers, and watch the enemy waste his ammo.
